question.text: Which of the following azeotropes is not correctly matched?

options.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  (68%)  <math><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math>  (32%): Maximum boiling azeotrope, boiling point = 393.5 K
<math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math>  (43%) + HI (57%): Minimum boiling azeotrope, boiling point = 290 K

<math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math>  (95.5%)  <math><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math>  (4.5%): Minimum boiling azeotrope, boiling point = 351.15 K

Chloroform (93.2%)  <math><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math>  (6.8%): Minimum boiling azeotrope, boiling point = 332.3 K

solution.text: <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math>  (43%) and HI (57%) make maximum boiling azeotropic mixture on boiling at 400 K.
